ablation.name: phase4i6a_sota_rk4_5ep
ablation.notes: Phase 4I.6a: SOTA (4H.1g) + RK4 solver + 5ep. STRUCTURAL: 4th-order ODE solver. Theory: Euler O(h^2) -> Heun O(h^3) -> RK4 O(h^4). If Heun broke Pareto (4I.2), RK4 should break it further. RK4 uses 4 forward calls per step (k1,k2,k3,k4 with weighted average). Test if higher numerical precision continues to compound gains. Goal: significantly beat SaMam (clip=0.7222, lpips=0.3282) on BOTH metrics. Current best: 4I.5b Heun+cosine (clip=0.7262, lpips=0.3171).
